snapshotGovernance: All existing frozen pre-kickoff model snapshots in data/model-snapshots.json are preserved unchanged. This audit is append-only and does not rewrite any pregame fair value.

predictionAndThesis.sjsuEmuTotal: Correct directional total thesis; entry beat close by 1.5 and game landed 48.
predictionAndThesis.sjsuEmuSide: Incorrect side thesis. Market also moved against EMU entry by one point and SJSU won outright. Review EMU Week 0 opponent adjustment and early-season small-favorite QB/defense uncertainty.
predictionAndThesis.toledoMsuTotal: Correct. Entry beat close by 2.0 and game landed 50 versus 49 fair; strong execution evidence.
predictionAndThesis.wyoCsuTotal: Incorrect outcome despite +0.5 CLV. CSU passing explosiveness and takeaways created scoring beyond modeled environment. Review explosive-pass/short-field tail treatment; do not broadly raise total weights.
predictionAndThesis.arkStMemSide: Lost despite +1.0 CLV. Arkansas State moved the ball but four Trey Owens interceptions, three in Memphis territory, were decisive. Treat as turnover-tail loss rather than automatic side-model downgrade.
predictionAndThesis.arkStMemTotal: Correct. Game produced 66 versus 55.5 fair and 52.5 entry. Memphis run efficiency and Arkansas State offensive capability were correctly identified; interception-driven short fields also inflated scoring.

componentPerformance.executionTiming: Positive: 4 of 6 entries beat close, one flat, one negative; average CLV +0.67 points.
componentPerformance.sideModel: Mixed/weak in settled officials: EMU and Arkansas State both lost; only Arkansas State showed positive market confirmation. Research priority, not production-weight change.
componentPerformance.totalModel: 2-1 among settled totals with strong CLV on two entries; Wyoming-CSU miss highlights explosive/turnover tail risk.
componentPerformance.expertIntelligence: Retain as qualitative residual. No evidence from six settled bets supports increasing expert weight; expert contradictions should continue to reduce confidence rather than mechanically move fair lines.

modelReview.calibrationConclusion: NO SYSTEM-LEVEL WEIGHT CHANGE. Week 1 remains incomplete and sample is small. Preserve preseason priors; apply only capped opponent-adjusted team/unit deltas. Research flags are separate from production changes.
researchFlags: Audit early-season small-favorite spread confidence after EMU miss.
Test explosive-pass and turnover-created short-field tail sensitivity in totals after Wyoming-CSU and Arkansas State-Memphis.
Continue execution-timing study; early/midweek price capture produced positive aggregate CLV.
Measure whether positive CLV with side losses persists before changing side activation or sizing rules.

underdogSpecialReview.conclusion: No Week 1 Special was persisted, so no ledger settlement exists. Colorado and San Jose State won outright despite failing frozen gates; those outcomes are learning evidence only and must not retroactively weaken the 2-of-3/profile/price rules. Hawaii's profile qualified but market band/ML price correctly vetoed the wager and Hawaii lost.
